voices.label: First Encounter
voices.en:
Hello. Call me Flutterpage. I used to live in Millwall with my mum and dad and sister ...
But that don't matter no more, does it?
voices.zh:
你好，我是纸信圈儿，我住在东伦敦的米尔沃尔，有父母和一个姐姐。
——但这些已经不太重要了，对吗？

voices.label: Suitcase Climate
voices.en:
London's always changing its weather.
Mostly it's foggy, and so smokey it'll make your throat sore; then it rains a lot, which pains Mum's knees ...
And sometimes—not too often—the sun comes out,
then everyone goes around sayin' "Lovely weather we're having, isn't it?"
voices.zh:
天气有一点糟，天气没那么糟……
雾对喉咙不好，雨对妈妈的膝盖不好，
晴天坏处最少，
但所有人会没完没了地讲“今天天气不错！”。

voices.label: To the Future
voices.en:
I got a lot of questions, but most of 'em seems even the adults don't know.
So I suppose I best figure them out myself.
voices.zh:
我有很多搞不懂的事，可大人也没有很明白。
我最好还是按自己的办法来。

voices.label: Idle
voices.en:
Hmm, she ain't lookin' at me, I don't think, just starin' off into space.
Can she hear me right now? Hard to tell, she could be pretendin'.
Sometimes I act like I can't hear nothing when really I was listenin'.
voices.zh:
不，我想她没有看我，她只是在发呆。
……我不确定她有没有听见我讲话。
我发呆时也常常假装没听见有人在喊我。

voices.label: Greetings
voices.en: A gust of wind from the door! I thought it was my arcane skill, but turns out it's you.
voices.zh: 风！我以为是我的神秘术，原来是你。

voices.label: Morning
voices.en:
I'm glad I woke you up.
Without a knocker-upper, people spend much too much time in bed and get themselves in a mess of trouble.
voices.zh:
你醒来了。
如果没有我叫人们起床，他们就很难醒过来，这是很危险、很严重的事情。

voices.label: Bond: Morning
voices.en:
It's always trouble rightin' my hair in the morning. It gets knotted up with all my strips.
I know I can untie the knots one by one, but it's such a pain. I usually just grab the scissors and go a choppin'.
voices.zh:
我不太擅长应对早上，头发和碎布条总是趁我睡觉时打结……
我有时候会花点时间慢慢地对付它们，更多时候会选择用剪刀。

voices.label: Night
voices.en:
It's past time I went to bed, but I could wait just a bit longer ...
'Cause I can't let you stay up too late, otherwise it'll be too hard to wake you up tomorrow.
voices.zh:
嗨。我该去睡觉了，但是我可以再等你一会儿……
我必须让你早点睡，这样明早我的叫醒工作才不会很困难。

voices.label: Bond: Night
voices.en:
Fancy going out tonight?
We could climb up the bell tower and catch a bit of fresh air. The roof's sure to be stone cold and damp,
but we'll hear the insects chirpin' and dogs barkin'.
If the wind gets strong enough, I'll take you into the air and we can fly up through the clouds,
When we get back, we can snuggle up to stay warm.
voices.zh:
你想出去吗？
爬上塔楼，石砖像乌龟壳一样又湿又凉，
能听见虫子、狗，
还有风，很大的风——我可以带你一起飞起来，
直到衣角变潮，那时候我们就一起钻进被窝。

voices.label: Hat and Hair
voices.en:
I like to cut my own hair.
But every time I done it, Mum always says I tangled it up so that it looks like a bird's nest ...
Course, she says it like it was a bad thing.
voices.zh:
我会自己剪头。
妈妈说它乱得像鸟巢——
她总是用批评的语气说一些夸奖我的话。

voices.label: Sleeves and Hands
voices.en:
This is a proper useful pole. It helps me hang clothes and wake up my clients.
It could even make for a handy slingshot—
Well, maybe not so handy for me,
'cause I'm too short to use it.
voices.zh:
它很好用，可以晾干衣服，可以叫醒大家。
它还很适合做弹弓，
只是对我来说有些长——
也许是我太矮了，不怪它。

voices.label: Clothing and Torso
voices.en:
Someone said I ought to fold up my strips before puttin' them in my pockets,
but that don't make no sense, does it? What if I need them fast? I can't bother with unfolding them in a pinch.
voices.zh:
有人说我应该把布条和小纸屑整理好再放进口袋，
可是——那就和“穿衣前先把衣服叠整齐”一样，是完全没有道理的！

voices.label: Hobby
voices.en:
I feel like some questions ain't got no answers in mind, but that's fine, ain't it?
Just like getting lost in the fog, sometimes you got to wander a bit before you find your way out.
voices.zh:
我有一种感觉，好像有些问题永远没有答案，但这件事并不让我害怕。
和在雾里一样，它会让人迷路，但其实哪里都可以走。

voices.label: Praise
voices.en:
You're so cute when you nap on the sofa, all scrunched up like a little kitten.
Huh?  Was I not supposed to look at you?
What's the difference if you were sleepin'?
voices.zh:
你睡觉时很可爱，会蜷成一团，像猫咪。
我不能在你睡觉时看你吗？
为什么现在看就可以？为什么观看与观看……也有区别？

voices.label: Intimacy
voices.en:
Mind if I follow you?
Oh, not that I ain't followin' you right now. I'm only standin' here to ask if you mind.
voices.zh:
我可以跟着你吗？
不，我现在还没跟着你呢，我只是站在这儿。

voices.label: Chitchat I
voices.en:
I like to dive in the laundry basket to hide from my mum and dad,
and you hide in the suitcase to avoid the "Storm."
No worries about it. No shame runnin' from what we can't handle.
voices.zh:
我藏进洗衣篮里避免挨骂，
你藏进箱子里躲开时间。
这都是一些我们暂时没办法处理的事情，躲起来并不丢脸。

voices.label: Chitchat II
voices.en:
To "die" means the ones you love can't see you anymore.
Don't matter much whether you're the one who leaves or the one left behind. You never get to see each other again.
Now I'm so far away from home and never returnin' again ...
Does that mean I already "died" once?
voices.zh:
“死掉”就是，再也见不到、找不到，
遗弃所有人，或者被所有人遗弃。
如果我离开家，离开原本的生活，并且再也回不去——
我也算是“死”过一回了吗？

voices.label: Monologue
voices.en:
Each morning, I watch folks gettin' up through their window frames, then they come right back to them at night.
Just like the old fairy tales, they all have the same beginning and the same end ...
But I ain't goin' to be like them, that's why I want to fly away—to find another end for my story.
voices.zh:
人们在一个个窗框里醒来，晚上再回到框子里，没有例外。
就像故事总是由“很久很久以前”开始，在“过上幸福生活”时结束。
我不想被装进框子，所以我总是想……飞走。

voices.label: Deployment
voices.en: Carrier pigeon Flutterpage at your service and rarin' to fly!
voices.zh: 如果你正巧需要一只信鸽……

voices.label: Pre-Battle
voices.en: Cor, what luck! I've got a letter headin' this way.
voices.zh: 这个方向正巧顺路。

voices.label: Select Incantation I
voices.en: Alright, who's who and where's what ...
voices.zh: 正在分拣。

voices.label: Select Incantation II
voices.en: Liberti Air Post, at your service!
voices.zh: 利伯蒂号专机。

voices.label: Select 3-star Incantation
voices.en: So many letters ... but I'll get them all out in a jiffy!
voices.zh: 好多信——但我还拿得动。

voices.label: Select Ultimate
voices.en: Oh, is this one for you?
voices.zh: 哪一封是你的？

voices.label: Cast Arcane Skill I
voices.en: Oi, here's a letter for you!
voices.zh: 嘿，你的信！

voices.label: Cast Arcane Skill I
voices.en: This one's come a long, long way.
voices.zh: 它走了很远。

voices.label: Cast Arcane Skill II
voices.en: Here, take a primrose!
voices.zh: 送你一朵报春花！

voices.label: Cast Arcane Skill II
voices.en: The wind'll lead the way.
voices.zh: 风会帮忙。

voices.label: Cast Ultimate
voices.en: Spring'll come, and the flowers will bloom again ...
voices.zh: 到明年春天，这里会长满新芽……

voices.label: Attacked I
voices.en: Oh, the stamp's fallen off!
voices.zh: 邮票弄掉了！

voices.label: Attacked II
voices.en: Oi! This ain't your letter!
voices.zh: 这不是你的信！

voices.label: Battle Victory
voices.en:
Victory—haha—everyone loves that!
I'll make sure to pass the word to anyone I meet along the way!
voices.zh:
我会把这个好消息告诉沿途的人，
每个人都喜欢多听到一次“胜利”！

voices.label: Insight
voices.en:
I've delivered so many letters that never found where they belonged.
It's like ... the wind carryin' a leaf in autumn—it's tryin' to take it home,
but there ain't no home left for it to go to.
I'm tryin' my best, but ... I don't know what else I can do.
voices.zh:
我投递过许多封无人收取的信，
它们像飘在空中的叶子。
但在它们本该去往的终点，正烧着成片的大火。
我不明白，我……也不知道我能做什么。

voices.label: Bottom of Insight
voices.en:
I suppose I'm really more like a bed sheet than a bird.
A sheet spends its entire life in three places:
first, stuck in the laundry; second, snugglin' up in bed; and third, hangin' in the air on the clothesline.
The last one is my favorite place to be.
voices.zh:
我不是鸟，而是一件衣服，
一生拥有三种样子：
在柜子里，在人们身边，在晾衣杆上。
我最喜欢第三种。
